name: Medallion  Vehicles - Authorized
description: This dataset lists authorized medallion vehicles, primarily New York City taxis, with 5,000 sampled records and 16 fields. Each row identifies a licensed driver or medallion holder by license number and name, along with license type and current status. Vehicle details include the DMV license plate number, VIN, vehicle type, model year, and medallion type. Records also include the associated agent's number, name, telephone number, website, and address, plus the date and time the record was last updated. The data can be used to look up vehicle and medallion information, analyze the mix of vehicle types and model years in the fleet, examine licensing status and medallion categories, study how medallions are distributed among agents, and track how recently records have been refreshed.
